descriptionHtml: During this session, a lot of details were discussed about the competitions to be organized by IAS. The resource persons described about the IAS CMD Myron Zucker contest, the undergraduate student design competition, the IAS CMD Student robotics demonstration contest and IAS CMD Humanitarian Contest. Here they mentioned the importance of these competitions, their global recognition and the rewards offered to the winners.
